digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler config schema and mapping foundation
propositions: Mapping block must be parsed as a reserved config section [tool.rebar.mapping] rather than coerced as typed JiraConfig keys, avoiding _warn_unknown hard-errors.
Axis maps (status_map, type_map, link_map, priority_map, create_defaults) must deep-merge per key across three layers (built-in ← default ← project-specific), with unnamed keys inheriting.
Vocabulary declarations (statuses, issue_types, link_types lists plus hierarchy table) must replace wholesale per layer, not union, so project vocabulary is authoritative-complete.
All axis-map values must validate offline fail-closed against effective declared vocabulary, with 'skip' as sole non-vocabulary sentinel value.
Capability descriptor dataclass must gate mapping axes (has_types, has_transitions, has_hierarchy, has_link_types, has_priorities) independent of backend operation Protocols.
mapping_config module must remain provider-neutral, importing no adapter code and carrying no vendor-specific literals.
